title: 6061-T6511 Bar Tolerances: Straightness, Twist, and What Extruded Bar Actually Arrives Like
summary: Extruded 6061-T6511 bar is not precision stock. Here are the tolerance realities on straightness, twist and dimension, when to pay for precision or manifold quality, and how much stock to leave.
body_markdown:
### How straight is extruded aluminum bar?


Commercial extruded bar is supplied to Aluminum Association standard straightness allowances published in Aluminum Standards and Data, which are looser than most machinists expect. Precision and manifold-quality extruded bar hold roughly half the commercial straightness and twist allowance and are the right choice when it matters.


### What is manifold quality aluminum bar?


A precision extruded product developed for hydraulic and pneumatic manifolds. It carries about half the commercial twist and straightness allowance, dimensional tolerance tightened and held entirely on the plus side so the bar is never undersize, and an elevated minimum ultimate strength of around 44 ksi.


### What tolerance is 6061-T6511 bar held to?


Commercial extruded bar follows Aluminum Association standard tolerances for dimension, straightness and twist. Manifold-quality material typically runs about +0.012 / -0.000 at 1 to 1.5 inches, widening to about +0.054 / -0.000 at 8 inches. Always ask for the figure on your specific section.


### How much material should I leave on extruded bar for machining?


About 0.060 inch per machined face on a short commercial extruded part, and 0.125 inch or more on long or thin sections where straightness and twist consume the rest. Precision or manifold material lets you come down to roughly 0.030 to 0.060 inch.


### How long is a standard stick of aluminum bar?


12 feet is the standard mill stock length for extruded 6061-T6511 bar. You pay for the full stick unless the supplier cuts it, and long bar often exceeds parcel length limits, so cutting to length frequently lowers the landed cost as well as the material cost.
